gapPhysicalSources.source: Unstunned Slow-Play Parry Farming vs Discrete Boss Attack Windows
gapPhysicalSources.mechanism: In continuous-time epoch relaxation, delaying stun via low-daze Dracaene parries (`717.6` daze vs Roxy Spin `1,487` daze/s) lets Sun harvest up to +1..+2 extra Ultimates (`+3,000..+6,000` Decibels) and +2..+3 extra `聚锋` cycles (`+120` WishFire each) without suffering buff/anomaly downtime.

To guarantee 100% admissibility (`0` false cuts), every hit in an epoch receives the maximum legal buff envelope for that phase (`fua_stacks=2`, `disc_stacks=3`, 100% `[极昼]` / `[众愿一心]` / `破风者` / `赤翼夜曲` / `[风化]` +18% uptime), even when Roxy reduces field time or before ramp-up stacks complete.

gapPhysicalSources.source: Continuous Frame Aggregation vs Discrete Hit-Frame & Cooldown Alignment
gapPhysicalSources.mechanism: Real `sim.rs` trajectories incur discrete dead-time waiting for golden flashes (`WaitFrames`), `[攻砭]` 10s Decibel ICD alignment, `1s` swap cooldowns (`swap_cd_until_f`), and non-preemptible animation boundaries.
